capabilities.title: Build platforms from zero
capabilities.text: I set up the delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure a new product needs, move monoliths to microservices, and take prototypes to product lines with real users.

capabilities.title: Introduce AI into production
capabilities.text: I've shipped LLMs and embeddings to production, backed by agent observability, and run experiments against real datasets to help with prompt engineering.

capabilities.title: Modernise infrastructure
capabilities.text: I led the platform's move to Kubernetes, helped migrate it from GCP to Azure, and recently worked with the .NET stack.

capabilities.title: Help set technical direction
capabilities.text: I design distributed systems that stay up and scale when they need to, and champion the best practices that keep them reliable.
